newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu opens first petrol station in China.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu opens first petrol station in China.

text.p: Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd, a Japanese refiner, said on Tuesday that it had opened its first petrol station in China in Dalian, and that it hoped to set up four more stations in the area by 2000.
It will aim for initial sales of 300 kilolitres (kl) per month, and hopes eventually to boost this to 500 kl, an Idemtisu spokesman told reporters.
The station, which opened on November 1, will be operated by Dalian Idemitsu China Co Ltd, a joint venture with the China National United Oil Corp.
The petrol station was built for a cost of about 80 million yen, Idemitsu said.
